---
name: Reconstruction request
about: Request a reference-based reconstruction or replacement-part job
title: "[reconstruction] "
labels: reconstruction
---

## Target part

Required. Name the exact subcomponent that needs to be modeled.

## References

Required. List measured references, public references, paid references, photos, meshes, or existing CAD.

## Measurements

Required. Record known dimensions, caliper notes, or scale anchors.

## Protected interfaces

Required. List the interfaces that must not drift, such as hole spacing, latch faces, pivots, slots, or insert seats.

## What is reused

Required. Identify any surrounding parts that already exist and will not be remodeled.

## What is not being modeled

Required. State the out-of-scope items so the job stays bounded.
